scientific_integrity: Every claimed equation is proved for the reduced complex quotient; symbolic checks supplement but do not replace invariant-theoretic arguments.
scientific_limitations: Only the reduced complex affine GIT character variety and its reduced trace-zero stratum are classified.
The proof invokes the established rank-three free-group invariant-ring trace generators and exact invariants for a characteristic-zero reductive group.
Unreduced representation-scheme nilpotents, real forms and arithmetic generalizations are not treated.
Unindexed equivalent older trace presentations cannot be ruled out by literature search alone.
title: A global smooth trace hypersurface for the three-crosscap \(\mathrm{SL}_2\) character variety
